incident-v2/restore.text: For a stalled ingestion pipeline, pause the scheduler before replaying the last successful checkpoint.

incident-v2/notify.text: For a stalled ingestion pipeline, notify the data platform on-call within 10 minutes.

incident-v1/restore.text: For a stalled ingestion pipeline, restart all workers before replaying the checkpoint.

quality-v2/threshold.text: The orders quality contract requires order_id to be unique and customer_id to be non-null.

quality-v2/quarantine.text: Quarantine an orders batch when duplicate order_id values exceed zero.

quality-copy/threshold.text: The orders quality contract requires order_id to be unique and customer_id to be non-null.

cost-v2/idle.text: Development compute must shut down after 30 idle minutes.

cost-v2/approval.text: Monthly cloud spend above 5000 synthetic credits requires FinOps approval.

cost-v1/idle.text: Development compute must shut down after 120 idle minutes.

sre-v2/sev1.text: A SEV1 incident requires paging the primary SRE immediately and the incident commander after 5 minutes without acknowledgement.

sre-v2/sev2.text: A SEV2 incident requires a service-owner ticket within 30 minutes.

access-v2/grant.text: Production data access requires manager approval and data-owner approval.

access-v2/expiry.text: Temporary production data access expires after 24 hours.

access-draft/grant.text: Production data access requires manager approval only.

adr-007/storage.text: ADR-007 selects Parquet for analytical storage because column pruning reduces scan bytes.

adr-007/index.text: ADR-007 keeps the transactional index in PostgreSQL to preserve row-level updates.

retention-a/retention.text: The analytics audit retention period is 90 days.

retention-b/retention.text: The analytics audit retention period is 365 days.

invented.text: The billing warehouse recovers in the lunar region.
